$comment: STUB(slopvac-8l4.2.20): Ref, Key, Level and CategoryDials duplicate RuleKey, RuleLevel and CategorySettings from config.schema.json (PR #279).
title: slopvac v3 style preset
description: An ordered preset of category and rule levels and of terms. A config lists styles in order and the last one wins. A style may extend other styles, which apply first. A style declares the styles it cannot combine with, and the host reports a conflict when both are active. Semantics are specified in docs/contract/packs.md. Owner: slopvac-8l4.2.4. The style name is the file name without its extension, qualified by the pack id. Maps merge by key and lists replace, as in config.schema.json.

extends.description: Styles applied before this one, lowest first.

conflicts.description: Styles that must not be active together with this one.

categories.description: Category dials, keyed by category name. A bare level sets the severity of every rule in the category. Keys are data, so the x- convention does not apply: an x- key is a rule or category name and takes a level.

rules.description: Rule levels, keyed by rule name. A rule entry wins over the category entry. Keys are data, so the x- convention does not apply: an x- key is a rule or category name and takes a level.

Ref.description: A style name: bare when unambiguous across the active packs, or <pack>:<name>.

Key.description: A rule or category name: qualified <pack>:<id> or a bare name. Same shape as RuleKey in config.schema.json.

Level.description: The level a rule or category reports at. off disables it.

allow.description: Words the style lets through the spelling check. A list replaces.

blocklists.description: Blocklist files, relative to this style file.

CategoryDials.description: Per-category dials. A bare level stands for { severity = <level> }. Mirrors CategorySettings in config.schema.json, so a style can carry what a 2.x profile set per category.

max_per_100_words.description: Density budget per 100 words. The string none clears a budget that a lower layer set, so the category has no budget. A higher layer cannot unset a field in any other way.

RelPath.description: A path relative to this file: no leading slash or drive letter, no backslash and no .. segment.
